# Atharva Jagtap — JagtapWorks

> Portfolio of Atharva Jagtap, a 2025 UBC Computer Science graduate based in Vancouver, BC. He builds systems that take manual work off people's hands: outreach automation and HR document generation at Vosyn, carbon-accounting software for a nonprofit, an AI policy-comparison pipeline for an insurance client, and test automation for provincial e-assessment platforms. Open to full-time roles in Canada.

The site is a single page styled as a star atlas with a day and a night mode. Case studies are told honestly: problem, what was built, what broke, outcome. Work is classified like star magnitudes: ● client work, ✦ startup, ✧ experiment.

## Site

- [Home](https://jagtapworks.com/): introduction, the path constellation, and the site index
- [Case studies](https://jagtapworks.com/#work): client work for Vretta, Arts Factory Society, Vosyn, and BFL Canada, the NxtMeals startup, and an experiments archive
- [About](https://jagtapworks.com/#about): bio, photo, and credentials
- [Contact](https://jagtapworks.com/#contact): email and links
